sources.citation: Starostin, George. 2015. Annotated Swadesh wordlists for the Jebel group (East Sudanic family): Aka, Molo, Kelo, Beni Sheko, Gaam. Global Lexicostatistical Database (Moscow), 38 pp. PDF description + HTML list view.
sources.note: Nothing stated. Transcription notes (pp.3-4) cover only segment/length conversions of Bender 1997's notation. The Aka forms, re-transcribed from Bender 1997 (AuU 80:204-211), preserve Bender's sporadic stress marks: 7 of 106 Aka items carry one, on varying syllables (təbbˈızi ~ təppˈısi 'all', mɛʓˈe, kˈeːgɛso, kˈeːkebe, ˈʋmuː-ke, ˈʋːgu, ˈaʓinˈiʓaːni) and one item carries a grave tone mark (fìli-ke) -- evidence that Bender noted stress occasionally, not a rule.

sources.note: Describes Gaahmg only; Aka, Molo, Kelo, Beni Sheko mentioned solely as related Eastern Jebel languages (classification/intro, lines 504-545); nothing on Aka prosody.
